{{Quote|Kreegyr's a separatist. Maya Pei's a neo-Republican. The Ghorman front. The Partisan alliance? Sectorists. Human cultists? Galaxy partitionists. They're lost!|Saw Gerrera rants to Luthen Rael|<ref name="Narkina 5" />}}
'''Maya Pei''' was the leader of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] during the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. The collective had connections with the [[Axis network|anti-Imperial network]] coordinated by the rebel [[agent]] [[Luthen Rael]].

==Biography==
===Notoriety===
{{Quote|Caleen gave us a list of every piece of gear that came through Ferrix. And I think we've already got a match to a targeting unit recovered from a safe house operated by a rebel cell associated with Maya Pei.|Dedra Meero, in a meeting with the [[ISB Board]]|<ref name="Nobody's Listening">{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}}</ref>}}
During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[neo-Republican]] Maya Pei<ref name="Narkina 5" /> led the [[Maya Pei Brigade]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> which became a notable rebel faction<ref name="Dawn" /> by [[5 BBY]].<ref name="5 BBY">{{AndorDate|109}}</ref> The collective had connections with the rebel [[agent]] [[Luthen Rael]], who coordinated an [[Axis network|anti-Imperial]] network which stole and traded stolen Imperial technology.<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], who worked with the network, helped it provide supplies for Pei and her rebels.<ref name="One Year Later" /> One cell associated with Pei attained a [[targeting unit]] from Rael's network, keeping it in a safehouse. The Empire eventually found the safehouse, recovering the targeting unit.<ref name="Nobody's Listening" />

Pei's group was one of many that was disliked by [[Saw Gerrera]],<ref name="Narkina 5" /> the leader of the extremist rebel group known as the [[Partisans]].<ref name="Dawn" /> Gerrera derided Pei and other rebel leaders with conflicting beliefs to Rael during one of their trade meetings<ref name="Narkina 5" /> in 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].<ref name="5 BBY" /> Around the same time, the Empire's [[Imperial Security Bureau]] apprehended [[Bix Caleen]],<ref name="Narkina 5" /> one of Rael's contacts on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] that sold him Imperial tech.<ref name="Dawn" /> After interrogating Caleen, [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] gathered a list of Imperial gear that passed through Ferrix, which included the targeting unit that was identified as the one eventually recovered from the safe house associated with Pei.<ref name="Nobody's Listening" />

===Rebels decimated===
{{Quote|I was trying to save her. We got ambushed. We lost six ships, forty fighters.|Gerdis, to Cassian Andor|<ref name="One Year Later" />}}
In [[4 BBY]], Maya Pei and her rebels were [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|ambushed]], leading to the loss of around forty personnel and six [[starship]]s. The [[Rebel trooper|rebel soldier]] [[Gerdis]], who claimed to be second-in-command of the brigade, attempted to save Pei but failed, believing that she was dead thereafter. Sixteen survivors from Maya Pei's cell then became stranded on the [[jungle]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> [[moon]]<ref name="Yavin 4 DB">{{Databank|yavin-4|Yavin 4}}</ref> of [[Yavin 4]] and another [[Bardi's brother|one]] took their remaining ship to go back for survivors. By that time, Cassian Andor and the rebel pilot [[Porko]] were using that same place as a meeting point for a [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|separate mission]]. Porko became hostile to the new arrivals and was killed, while Andor was captured by them when he arrived with a stolen [[TIE Avenger prototype]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

Upon finding out what the rebel group was, Andor mentioned his connection to Pei, to no avail, and Gerdis and fellow rebel [[Bardi]] were in disagreement on whether Pei was still alive. The distrust among the group of survivors grew, with more arguing on whether Maya or anyone else would come back for them.<ref name="One Year Later" /> This led to infighting and the deaths of some of the soldiers, Andor escaping in the TIE Avenger during the chaos.<ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Maya Pei was first mentioned in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]],"<ref name="Narkina 5" /> the eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of [[Tony Gilroy]]'s live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was released on [[October 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="S1 Companion">{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}}</ref>
